interface Event { name: string; date: string }
const e: Event = { name: "a", date: "b" };
interface Location { x: number; y: number }
const l: Location = { x: 1, y: 2 };
interface Algorithm { x: number }
function run(a: Algorithm): number { return a.x; }
run({ x: 1 });
class Body { n = 1 }
const b: Body = { n: 2 };
console.log(new Body().n);
interface Text { body: string }
const t: Text = { body: "x" };
interface Comment { author: string }
const cm: Comment = { author: "a" };
interface Notification { message: string }
function notify(n: Notification): string { return n.message; }
interface Position { x: number; y: number }
const p: Position = { x: 1, y: 2 };
interface KeyAlgorithm { name: string; size: number }
const k: KeyAlgorithm = { name: "k", size: 1 };
console.log(e, l, b, t, cm, notify, p, k);
